The capacity planning task succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating the effectiveness of the LangChain graph implementation.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.81 across one trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.366s. Results were successfully serialized to result.json, validating the stability of the adhoc claude-code and gpt-5.2 integration.
